courses.title: Organizational Development for Finance Managers
courses.description: Organizational Development for Finance Managers focuses on organizational development for people working toward a Senior Finance Manager role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces forecasting and budgeting, enough to apply alongside organizational development in real Senior Finance Manager work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to organizational development and show how forecasting and budgeting supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying organizational development to a real Senior Finance Manager scenario
Practicing organizational development through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to forecasting and budgeting
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Financial Reporting Standards for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of financial reporting standards, for people already working toward a Senior Finance Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in financial reporting standards and want to go further.

courses.title: Cost Management Basics
courses.description: Cost Management Basics walks you through the basics of cost management, built for people new to Senior Finance Manager work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of cost management, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

alternates.title: Advanced Organizational Development Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Organizational Development Techniques is a focused course on organizational development for people already working toward a Senior Finance Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying organizational development on your own.
